messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 10):
"""
The Insurer is required to have robust system of Grievance Redressal Process. The response letter of the Insurer in any grievance shall include the contact details of concerned insurance ombudsmen where his/her complaint can be escalated in case, the policyholder is not satisfied by the grievance redressal provided by the Insurer. 20) Implementation of Ombudsman Award: The Insurer is required to comply with the award of the Insurance Ombudsman within 30 days of receipt of award by the Insurer. In case the Insurer does not honour the ombudsman award, a penalty of Rs. 5000/- per day shall be payable to the complainant. Such penalty is in addition to the penal interest liable to be paid by the Insurer under The Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What must an insurer include in its response letter to a grievance?","answer":"It must include the contact details of the concerned insurance ombudsman so the complaint can be escalated if the policyholder is not satisfied.","facts":["contact details of concerned insurance ombudsmen","complaint can be escalated"]},{"question":"How long does an insurer have to comply with an Insurance Ombudsman award and what penalty applies if it fails to do so?","answer":"The insurer must comply within 30 days of receiving the award, and if it does not honour the award it must pay Rs. 5000 per day to the complainant, plus penal interest.","facts":["within 30 days of receipt of award","penalty of Rs. 5000/- per day"]}]}
